summary: Expanded the restaurant sanitation / food-safety / QA node with a two-lane universe. Ecolab is the obvious reference anchor for restaurant sanitation, food-safety programs, and chain-level operating consistency. The underfollowed lane is more interesting but evidence is uneven: Neogen has direct food-safety testing exposure, Rentokil/Steritech has direct third-party restaurant audit exposure but is not small-cap, and Ascent Industries is a speculative micro-cap specialty-chemical lead with HI&I exposure but unproven restaurant/foodservice revenue. No recommendation is implied; these are research candidates for later evidence gating.
